Also helps w/ eye sxs (itchy, watery eyes)

More drowsiness than loratadine, faster onset
: blocks muscarinic receptors of mucous glands to decrease watery nasal d/c

roles.drugs: Persistent allergic rhinitis: intranasal glucocorticoids (eg, fluticasone, mometasone); vasomotor rhinitis: of some benefit (eg, mometasone 2 sprays BID)
Acute (viral) rhinitis, symptomatic: 2nd-gen antihistamines (eg, cetirizine, fexofenadine) preferred over 1st-gen, which are more anticholinergic
Intranasal antihistamine (azelastine, olopatadine), alone or with an intranasal steroid
Intranasal ipratropium for rhinorrhea (less effective in allergic rhinitis; helpful in vasomotor rhinitis)
Nasal mast cell stabilizer (cromolyn), less effective
Montelukast, used cautiously (boxed warning, neuropsychiatric effects); not for nonallergic rhinitis
Decongestants: short-term only, not beyond 3–5 days; avoid topical ones in nonallergic rhinitis
Omalizumab or dupilumab when allergic rhinitis coexists with uncontrolled persistent asthma and chronic rhinosinusitis with polyps
